The '''Morseer system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained [[Morseer]],<ref name="TTaBS" /> a colony world of the [[Morseerian/Legends|Morseerian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="UAA" /> Morseer was controlled by the [[Drackmarian]]s until they were defeated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TTaBS" />
